verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party AI pages describe several in-product AI insights. 'Today' is an intelligent briefing that signals what needs your attention, and Slackbot is a personal AI agent that analyzes reports, prepares for meetings, creates briefs and digs into open-ended questions. Slack AI also summarizes channels and threads, delivers daily recaps, and turns huddles into takeaways and action items. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and in-depth documentation (beyond marketing copy) of how suggestions are generated from workspace and integrated data.
